clues.text: Riders on this thrill machine rocket up to 73 mph, soar to heights of 178 feet, and flip through two inversions.
This coaster was manufactured by Intamin and debuted to riders in 2022.
You will find this attraction operating at a popular theme park in Virginia.
The coaster's dynamic layout features four launches, three of which take place on a swing launch between a vertical spike and a top hat.
The ride takes its name from a Greek word referring to a particular set of gods.

evidence.quote: Pantheon is a steel roller coaster at Busch Gardens Williamsburg theme park in Williamsburg, Virginia, United States.
The ride's layout includes four launches – three of which take place on a swing launch between the vertical spike and top hat.
''Pantheon'' is a Greek word referring to a particular set of Gods.
